subject: Human Evolution
title: Mammoth Steppe
description: Learn Mammoth Steppe in one minute.

hook.text: The largest biome that ever existed is gone. Mammoth steppe once covered more land than any living ecosystem.

buildup.text: Cold, dry grasslands stretched from Spain to Canada, supporting mammoths, bison, horses, and woolly rhinos.

discovery.text: Dense herds fertilized the soil and kept it grassy. When they vanished, mossy tundra took over.

twist.text: Some scientists want to rewild the steppe with bison and horses to restore this ancient ecosystem.

climax.text: The mammoth steppe shows how animal populations and landscapes shape each other across millennia.

punchline.text: The biggest grassland ever vanished with its herds.

quiz.question: What was the mammoth steppe?
options: A vast cold grassland supporting megafauna across Eurasia
